name: Singed
notes: Poison Trail is toggled on before the fight starts and Singed is assumed to stand on the stationary dummy the whole time, so its cloud has 100% uptime on the target for the whole fight; this settles the dossier's uptime question in favor of full uptime.

Poison Trail's tick damage (base/4 per tick, AP ratio 0.10625 per tick) is dealt every 0.25 s continuously; the wiki's 'extra instance on first application' is applied exactly once, at the very start of the fight, since every later tick is a refresh of the same debuff rather than a fresh application.

Toggling Poison Trail is not an ability activation (the wiki states this explicitly), so its ticks do not call ability_cast_proc, eclipse_hit or prime_spellblade, and never trigger the 0.25 s cast lockout.

Insanity Potion is cast immediately at t = 0 for its 25 s buff, which covers the entire fight; only its AP term is modeled since it also boosts Poison Trail and Fling, while its armor/MR/movement speed/regen do not change damage dealt to a stationary dummy.

Fling is cast on cooldown for its burst magic damage (flat + AP ratio + target max-health ratio); it has a 0.25 s cast time, kept as gen.E.castTimeS, so it keeps Singed busy for that long and Poison Trail's next tick (which is not a cast) can still land in that window while Fling itself cannot overlap another cast. The wiki's note that a basic attack can land on the airborne target is treated as a positional corner case and not modeled as a bonus attack.
Mega Adhesive is never cast: it deals no damage and only slows/grounds, which is irrelevant against a target that never moves or acts.
Grievous Wounds applied by Poison Trail while Insanity Potion is active is ignored: the dummy never heals, so it never changes damage dealt.
Noxious Slipstream (passive) only grants Singed movement speed and never affects damage dealt or taken, so it is not modeled.
Mana is not modeled: Poison Trail's per-second cost and Fling/Insanity Potion's flat costs are assumed sustainable for the fight window at level 16.
Basic attacks are otherwise plain: Singed has no on-hit, attack-speed steroid, or attack reset, so attacks use engine defaults and are woven in between Fling casts.
